title: First Presbyterian Church of Rowlett, Texas v. North Texas Presbytery
disposition_detail: Appeal abandoned under BCO 43-7; North Texas Presbytery's judgment affirmed.
first_summary: First Presbyterian Church of Rowlett appealed after North Texas Presbytery reversed the Session's indefinite suspension of two members who had begun attending other churches. The SJC did not reach the asserted procedural errors because the Session advised that it would start over and would not pursue the appeal. Under BCO 43-7, the appeal was abandoned and Presbytery's judgment was affirmed.

evidence_notes.qualifications: The SJC did not decide the asserted gross-irregularity and evidentiary issues on their merits.
